citationText: A-3 Dimension G, the distance between adjacent framelines, has been limited carefully so as to make it possible to keep both frame lines masked simultaneously by the projector aperture. In addition, dimensions F and H have been established to limit the distance that any part of the frame-line can depart from the bottom edge of the perforations. This is to minimize the necessity for frequent adjustment of the framing device on the projector.
